cohort: The study included 20 patients who had undergone hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT) and were refractory to conventional vitamin D therapy, presenting with serum vitamin D levels ≤35 ng/mL.
finding: The oral thin film cholecalciferol significantly improved serum vitamin D levels in all 20 previously refractory patients, increasing from a median of 29.2 ng/mL to 58 ng/mL after 12 weeks, with no observed toxicity.
